title: Admin Portal Quiz Registry & Sync Fix (v0.4.44)
message: Fixed the Quiz Attempt Logs registry freeze in the Web Admin Portal and synchronized student quiz history loading.
changelog:
🛠️ QUIZ ATTEMPT REGISTRY & SYNC FIX v0.4.44:
• Quiz Attempt Logs Registry Fix: Restored global loadAllQuizAttempts export and unshadowed shared attempt state so the Quiz & Practice Attempts Hub loads immediately.
• Live Sync & Scope Filtering: Synchronized late-arriving student rosters and standardized timed assessment submissions with school-scoped filtering and Firestore timestamp normalization.
